decision_rule: Targeted check (not a sample) under the coordinator rulings of 2026-11-17 (mining consultation 22, R9-closeout). Age plants: the date is a first-posted date only if the board's raw data shows it (raw JSON date, requisition/JobId order, no batch stamp); a raw date 60 days to 12 months old with the posting live today = 20; over 12 months = standing ad, 12 unless several counted postings, a sign-on bonus or mandatory overtime. Flow plants: a careers-page ad counts (12) only with an apply flow for that job (ATS, application form, or email/apply instruction covering it). Corrected = misdated (re-post stamp written as a posting date), a clause the cited page does not carry, or points that differ under the rule. Unreachable = page cannot be reached without sign-in.
